items.question: Does the Emirates Drug Establishment regulate medical products in the UAE, including those in free zones?
items.gold: Yes, it manages and regulates medical products in the UAE, including the free zones.
items.fact: Emirates Drug Establishment regulates medical products nationwide, including free zones

items.question: Which body is the federal health authority in the UAE that provides preventive and curative healthcare to citizens and residents?
items.gold: The Ministry of Health and Prevention (MoHaP).
items.fact: Ministry of Health and Prevention is the UAE federal health authority
